_comment: Developer additions merged into the generated model on every `npm run generate`. Keys are intent names; values are sample utterances following Alexa's rules (lowercase words, known {slots}, one AMAZON.SearchQuery slot alone with a carrier phrase). Intents that the current MCP server does not have are ignored with a note, so overrides for several example servers can live here together.
FindParkIntent: what is the best national park for {activity}
what is the best national park in {month}
where should i go for {activity} in {month}
SearchHotelsIntent: find me a place to stay in {destination}
_comment_counterpart: Counterpart (github.com/Raul99Alejandro/counterpart): phrasings from its demo script that the generated model routed to the wrong intent or to Fallback in the simulator.
